decisions.reason: The IMU module sits close to the firm's established sensor modules, gained a page of its own in 2024, and its own R&D lets the firm interpret results and keep improving it.

The industrial AC input module builds directly on the firm's modular platform, has been consistently presented on its own page with a specific launch announcement, and fits its industrial automation knowledge.

The solid state relay module is a close extension of existing relay and control modules, so the firm can easily assimilate feedback, though its only modest website presence slightly raises the risk of being replaced by a newer version.
The RGB LED control module builds on the firm's existing LED and PWM modules within the interoperable building-block system, where in-house hardware and firmware knowledge supports refinement.

The remote access service for wallboxes extends the strategically growing charging and energy-management line, so it fits the firm's direction, although service operations are somewhat further from its hardware core.
